This notice describes the website preview you are viewing and the project-brief tool it contains.

Preview notice. The publication date will be set at launch.

What you can enter

The brief tool asks for your name, company or property, email address, project location, area of interest and a project description. Use only information you are comfortable including in a project brief.

Where your brief goes

The tool prepares text within the current browser tab. It does not send the brief to GEM or to an enquiry service. The site does not save the form to browser storage. Reloading or clearing the page removes its working form state; your browser may separately offer autofill.

Copying and downloading

Copying places the prepared brief on your device’s clipboard. Downloading saves a text file to your device. You control any later sharing of that text or file. Clearing the form does not remove a downloaded file or clear your clipboard.

Cookies and analytics

This preview does not set analytics or marketing cookies, use tracking scripts, or request third-party fonts. The logo and fonts are served with the site. Your browser makes the requests needed to load the pages and assets; the serving environment may record technical request information. Our hosting and network provider may store a security cookie called cf_clearance to support security checks and reduce repeated challenges. In our checks on 26 October 2026, this cookie appeared on both language versions with an expiry on 26 October 2027. Its duration may vary with the provider’s security configuration. We did not observe advertising or analytics cookies in those checks. A notice at the top of each page describes this cookie. Closing the notice is remembered only for the current browser session, using session storage; nothing else is stored.

Information to leave out

Do not enter payment details, identity-document numbers, health information, confidential guest information or other sensitive personal data. This tool is intended for an initial business brief.

Operator and privacy contact

Operator: GEM, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Privacy contact: contact@mish3l.com.

Hosting and logs

Our hosting and network provider delivers this site and may record technical request information. Records may include request paths and hosts, IP addresses, countries, browser, operating-system and device types, status codes, security actions, cache and origin timings, and DNS queries. We use them to deliver the website, maintain its security and availability, detect and investigate abuse, and diagnose technical faults. Access is limited to authorised personnel and service providers as necessary for the stated purposes. Retention period: [RETENTION PERIOD — PENDING].

Requests and changes

We acknowledge requests about your personal data within 5 working days and handle applicable requests without undue delay and within 30 calendar days, subject only to a lawful extension notified with reasons. We update this notice and its date.

Still being finalised

Retention periods and the wording of your rights under applicable law are being finalised with our adviser. This notice covers the current tool and the hosting arrangements described above; it is not a statement about a future enquiry service.
